primarySources.facts: 18+; eligible Workspace edition or Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra; edition and AI plan feature tables; Ask Gemini at top right as the access check; US AI Pro/Ultra Gmail side-panel footnote; US no-charge Gmail features for personal accounts; language note.

29 side-panel languages; Help me write 8 languages (personal US only); Proofread English/Spanish; other features English-only.
Smart features in Google Workspace controls Google Workspace with Gemini; off by default in EEA/Japan/Switzerland/UK; Gmail and Drive settings paths; web-only to turn on; applies across devices.
Feature access per service; default on; Enterprise Standard/Plus, Teaching and Learning, Education Plus, AI Pro for Education; Gemini app toggle separate; users need smart features on.
Admin default options; users can override; regional default off; up to 24 hours; refresh tabs.
Gemini Beta (formerly Alpha) off by default; admin-only; OU/group scope; Docs features listed.
Daily reset 12 AM PT; monthly reset first of month; no rollover or pooling; AI Expanded Access add-on.
Workspace Experiments: personal accounts, 18+, not for Workspace accounts; gradual rollout; English-only features; exiting is permanent.
Experiments available in 170+ countries and territories (list includes Pakistan, India, UK, US).
